external_source_review.reason: All reference claims are supported by the cited curated repository passages; no current fees, school offerings or new external facts are required. External websites were not reverified.

execution_contract.case_id_use: Capture correlation only; do not include in the agent prompt.
execution_contract.state: Replay conversation_history user turns in order with returned profile carried forward; fresh service per case. Only final answer receives RAGAS scoring.
execution_contract.label_visibility: cases.jsonl, manifest.json and review.md are evaluation-only. Never supply references, reference passages, sources, checks or expected behaviour to the answering agent. Load cases.jsonl only for scoring/review.
execution_contract.behaviour_scoring: Review each explicit check for pass/fail with a reason; no RAGAS pass thresholds.
execution_contract.held_out: Reserve held_out for reporting after tuning; do not use its outputs to tune prompts or labels.

version_policy: Change the dataset version and refresh file hashes whenever a question, setup, label or evidence snapshot changes. Retain this version for compatible baseline comparisons.
